newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 19 injured in India bomb blast on buses.
newsitem.headline: At least 19 injured in India bomb blast on buses.

text.p: At least 19 people were injured in two blasts aboard buses in the old quarter of the Indian capital on Monday, the United News of India news agency said on Monday.
The news agency reported the blasts, both close to the historic Red Fort, occurred within 10 minutes of each other, and police suspected crude explosive devices were used.
Earlier a police spokesman told Reuters that at least six people were injured in one of the explosions.
"There has been a blast on a bus. We do not know if it was a bomb," the spokesman said. "At least six people are injured."
Four people were injured on Saturday when inflammable chemicals exploded on a bus in the same neighborhood.
Thirty-three people were killed and 64 injured last week when a powerful bomb exploded on a train in the nearby state of Punjab, which was rocked by a Sikh separatist movement in the 1980s.
